Fold the helper into rouvr/activities.py and the receipt tests into tests/test_r9_close.py, or record an approved scope amendment on the sheet. 3) Operator path: .env.example contains no RECEIPT_SIGNING_KEY_PATH/RECEIPT_KEY_ID (0 matches) although docs/configuration.md:11-12 documents both and refers readers to .env.example; add both entries. Note: AC-1..AC-4 all pass functionally in the current venv (supervisor re-runs: 31 receipt/workflow tests, 87 in tests/, 152 passed+2 skipped public suite, hygiene clean, lifecycle valid, plus an independent 13-check probe covering wrong-key, tampered payload/digest/signature, unknown key_id, rotation pool, 0644/0640/0604/0777 refusal, missing key); rework is packaging/scope only, then resubmit.
